reason: I'm a student and I already pay for Calm, and my sounds and routine are all set up there. I might try the free 14 days since it doesn't auto-charge, but I'm not paying for a second sleep app on my budget.
objection: I'd have to drop Calm to make room for this, and I'm not sure a fade-out timer is worth switching for. I also sleep with earphones in, so I don't know if the phone-on-the-bed tracking even works for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fall asleep a lot faster than with my usual app, and it had enough sounds that I could cancel Calm and pay for just this one.
